description: Source code for the MobileModelRunner class, which handles bundling inputs, running model methods, and processing tensors in a mobile PyTorch JIT context.

classes.name: MobileModelRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for managing bundled inputs, executing model methods, and processing tensors in a mobile environment.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Converts a c10::IValue containing a list of tuples into a vector of vector of IValues.

methods.name: ivalue_to_bundled_inputs_map
methods.description: Converts a c10::IValue containing a dictionary into a map from function names to input function names.

methods.name: get_all_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves all bundled inputs from the model.

methods.name: get_many_functions_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Retrieves bundled inputs for multiple functions.

methods.name: run_with_inputs
methods.description: Runs the model with provided bundled inputs.

methods.name: run_with_inputs (overload)
methods.description: Runs a specific function with provided bundled inputs.

methods.name: run_argless_functions
methods.description: Executes a list of functions without inputs.

methods.name: set_has_metal_gpu_operators
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator list contains Metal GPU operators.

methods.name: for_each_tensor_in_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Applies a function to each tensor within the bundled inputs.
